spanish: Y todo lo que cayere desde su cadáver sobre él se impurecerá; horno y fogones serán derribados; impuros ellos, e impuros serán a ustedes.

findings.issue: The carcass suffix is 3mp; su does not mark plural possessors.
Morphology is masculine dual; fogones is an unmarked plural.
Hophal imperfect is 3ms; serán derribados is plural agreement with the compound subject.

notes: Repetition, ellos, hophal passive, and לכם as a ustedes stay inside the tokens.
